title: Use Units and Land Measurements
readerIntent: Configure measured products and stock without mixing dimensions.
priorKnowledge: Know the product and inventory measurement requirements.
owner: Units owns definitions/conversions; consuming modules own business meaning
summary: Define stable units, compatible dimensions, canonical conversion, precision, and rounding before using them in Product or Inventory.

sections.heading: Examples
items: Area: square metre, hectare, acre and configured land units.
Length and other dimensions only through compatible definitions.

sections.heading: Implementation
items: Choose dimension, code, symbol, canonical unit, conversion factor, precision, and rounding.
Preserve original value/unit for audit and normalize only through Units services.
Reject incompatible conversions such as kilograms to litres without a domain-owned density rule.
Test zero, fractional, maximum precision, rounding, conversion chains, locale display, and regression.
